rationale: This record is a clinical hematology laboratory study evaluating quality assurance methods and anticoagulants for CD34+ cell enumeration and white blood cell counts, with no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings because the study is an off-topic clinical hematology laboratory quality assurance evaluation unrelated to water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Australasian CD34+ quality assurance program and rationale for the clinical utility of the single-platform method for CD34+ cell enumeration
The effects of different anticoagulants on WBCC of 12 peripheral blood samples (PBs) were compared using three cell counters.
